### ① Derived judgments

1. Diff extent: three files, +39 / −6 — the eval file (+15 / −5), the ratchet script (+12 / −1, one hunk: the row comment and the row value), the new changeset (+12). No other path, no published schema, no package source. Correct.
2. Cherry-pick fidelity: `git diff 1c67d742~1 1c67d742 -- skills .changeset` and `git diff origin/main...ee7516b7 -- skills .changeset` are identical after dropping the index lines (diff of diffs empty). Commit d1f1c892 carries 1c67d742's message and its own session trailer. The ratchet row is the only addition, in commit ee7516b7. The thread's claim "cherry-picked unchanged, plus the one ruled row" is true.
3. `currency:@currency_code` is accepted: `CURRENCY_ARGUMENT_RULE` (template-engine.ts L192–195) admits the `@` path form "in a mail template only"; mail-hole-grammar.ts parses the path as `codePath` and, when the template declares `variables`, refuses an undeclared one (`currency-code-path-undeclared`, L156–161). The eval's "only a mail template may read the code from the send's data" is true: the in-app dialect refuses it by name (`currency-code-path-mail-only`, L417–425).
4. The bare `currency:currency_code` is refused: template-engine.ts L413–415 — an argument that is not a currency code and carries no `@` path is `currency-code-literal`, in every dialect. The eval's "A bare path is refused" is true, and the must_not_contain string is a real wrong form, not a stylistic one.
5. No-argument `| currency`: `currencyDefaultRefusal` (template-engine.ts L240–260) formats in the tenant default `localization.currency` and refuses at render when none is set; template-currency-tenant-default.test.ts pins CNY / EUR / JPY defaults and pins that nothing formats in USD. The eval's "no argument means the organization's default currency" follows the implementation; the card's original "US dollars" was corrected by the dev (6488686813) and the director accepted the correction (6493978216). Correct.
6. "The stored code is three capitals (`EUR`), exactly as stored": `currencyCodeValueRefusal` (L328–336) accepts only `CURRENCY_CODE_RE` (three capitals) and refuses lowercase or padded values at render. True.
7. "when the template declares `variables`, the path must be one of them or lie under one": `isDeclaredPath` (mail-hole-grammar.ts L123–125) is `name === path || path.startsWith(name + '.')`; the spec's `variables[].name` description (email-template.zod.ts L117–119) says the same. True.
8. Assertion fairness and self-agreement, checked by hand on the head's file text: every must_contain string (`currency:@`) is in its own expected_output; none of the four must_not_contain strings is in case 8's prompt or expected_output; `currency:@currency_code` does not contain `currency:currency_code` (the `@` breaks the substring); `| currency:@currency_code }}` does not contain `| currency }}`. All 8 cases, 0 failures. The expected_output names the three wrong forms descriptively ("a bare path", "a literal code", "no argument") without spelling them, so a correct answer that follows the reference does not trip the refusals; an answer that quotes a wrong form verbatim to warn against it would trip, which is the house rule the card's Wanted and the ruling fixed (the four strings are ruled verbatim).
9. Consistency with SKILL.md: L448–450 on `origin/main` teaches "A `currency` argument is a literal code (`currency:EUR`); only an email template may read it from the send's data instead, `{{ amount | currency:@currency_code }}`". Case 8's expected form and its mail-only clause are that teaching; the capitals and declared-variables facts come from the implementation and the spec and do not contradict the skill. SKILL.md is untouched in the diff. Consistent.
10. The six trims (cases 1, 2, 4, 5, 7; measured −14, −59, −22, −22, −43 B = −160 B): each removes a restatement or a connective and keeps the assertion and the fact — case 1 drops "is CEL via" (the `F` tag is the CEL tag); case 2 drops "Applies the mechanical … table:", "noting that", "the expression" and "declared-" (inversion, keep-the-failing-condition and the nullable guard all kept); case 4 drops the label "the determinism gate:" and keeps the byte-identical rule; case 5 rephrases "whose predicate dominates the comparison" and shortens "publish-time gate" to "publish gate" (the null tests ahead of the comparison and the `has()` refusal kept); case 7 drops "Both are predicates over the STORED value:" whose judgment the closing clause "compare the stored value, never its option label" still carries. No prompt, `files`, `must_contain` or `must_not_contain` of cases 1–7 changed (compared field by field on `origin/main` and the head); cases 3 and 6 are untouched. Correct.
11. Ratchet row: `['skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json', 1506]` at L1052; the file is 6021 bytes on the head, ceil(6021 / 4) = 1506, headroom 0, matching the row comment's arithmetic (5407 − 160 = 5247 → 1312; 5247 + 774 = 6021 → 1506; case 8 measured at 774 B). The comment names card #26940, the ruling comment id 6512920986, letter A, and quotes the binding clause 「26940同意」 verbatim; the PR body quotes the maintainer's whole sentence and carries `Ruling-ref: 6512920986`. The header's one permitted other direction ("a PR whose body quotes a maintainer ruling authorizing it", L127–129) is met. Correct.
12. Changeset: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; the package exists at packages/skills and sits in the `fixed` group of .changeset/config.json, so a patch is the right level for a shipped-eval change (the same shape as the prior skills changesets in the tree). Its "Six reference answers … shortened" and "every assertion and fact kept" claims are true per item 10. Correct.

### ② Semver level

Patch on `@objectstack/skills`; the PR body and the changeset both carry `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. No published schema, key, runtime behaviour or formatter whitelist changes; the eval file is shipped content and the ratchet row is a repo gate constant. Level and declarations agree.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flags (6514690365 deviations): platform branch name instead of `claude/issue-26940-*` (recorded in the claim); cherry-pick onto `origin/main` rather than a branch off the WIP branch (verified unchanged, ① item 2); assignee set at pr_create; row comment quotes only the binding clause while the PR body quotes the whole sentence (verified); shallow clone. None affects the tree. Answered.
- `open_questions`: none in 6514690365. The blocked round's one question (6488686813) was ruled A by 6512920986; this head implements exactly A and none of A′ / B / C / D.
- Two gate families NOT MEASURED locally (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, whole-tree dist) are CI's; the diff touches no package source.
- Counting note, not a flag: the dev and the PR say "six trims", the ruling says "five lossless trims" — five cases, six listed edits (case 5's two counted as one item), seven textual substitutions. The byte total (−160) is what the row comment and the arithmetic rest on, and it is exact.
- Card's "US dollars" sentence: superseded by the implementation reading (① item 5); the ruled must_not_contain list is unchanged, as the ruling binds.
- CI at this head (41 check-runs, read twice at about 04:07Z and 04:09Z): 0 failure, 0 cancelled; 38 completed (success or skipped by path filter), 3 still in_progress at the last read — Test Core (1/8), Test Core (2/8), Lint · scoped · slot lookup and corpus. Green so far: Lint · docs and code guards, Lint · repo and tooling gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · CI/release/engine gates, all Type Check jobs, Build Core, Test Core (3/8) and (4/8), Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Auto Label. The ratchet gate and its self-test run in lint.yml (L5462–5463). The landing-time check-all-green condition is the dispatch seat's to confirm once the three finish.

### ④ Design judgment

`skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json` against the card's Wanted and the spec on `main`: the card asks for one case whose prompt requests an `email_template` showing each contract's overdue amount in its own currency, expecting `{{ amount | currency:@currency_code }}` with the capitals and declared-path facts, must_contain `currency:@`, must_not_contain the bare path, `currency:USD`, `currency:CNY` and `| currency }}`. Case 8 is exactly that; each fact in its reference answer holds against template-engine.ts, mail-hole-grammar.ts, email-template.zod.ts and the tenant-default test (① items 3–7), and the answer teaches the three wrong forms by description so the reference itself passes its own refusals. The scenario is the one the renderer cannot catch for an AI author (a hard-coded code renders silently in one currency for every record; the no-argument form renders silently in the tenant default), which is what an eval, not a gate, must score. The trims pay 40 of the 194 tokens without removing a judgment; the remaining 154 are paid by the ruled row, pinned at the measurement with zero headroom, which keeps the ratchet's shrink-only discipline for every later edit. The ruling 6512920986 is quoted in the PR body as the header requires and its id is in the row comment; the second clause of the maintainer's sentence (an evaluation of the ceiling's value) is correctly kept out of this PR. The change holds against the code it cites and the acceptance scenario.
